Ultra Talking Pulse is for general wellness and information only. It is not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition and must not be used for any medical decision. AI explanations are generated automatically and can be wrong. If you are worried about your health, talk to a doctor.

Turn on the AI explanation?

After each measurement or breathing exercise, the app can ask an AI to explain your results in a few plain sentences, including whether each value is within, below or above the typical range for adults.

• To do that, the measured numbers (pulse, breathing rate and heart rate variability) are sent to Presage, which passes them to a large language model. Video and images never leave the phone.
• The explanation is written by an AI. It can be inaccurate or wrong.
• It is general information only, never a diagnosis or medical advice.

You can turn this off again at any time.

My camera-based wellness readings, taken at rest, are: %1$s. In three to five short, plain sentences: for each reading, give the typical resting range for adults and say whether my value is within it, below it or above it. Then add one neutral sentence of general context. Do not diagnose, do not name any illness, and do not give medical advice or instructions. If a value is outside the typical range, only say that such values can vary for many ordinary reasons and may be worth mentioning to a doctor if it keeps happening. Write plain text with no lists, headings or Markdown. Answer in English.

I just did a two-minute guided breathing exercise: in for 4 seconds, out for 6, about 6 breaths a minute. My camera-based wellness readings were: %1$s. In three to five short, plain sentences: say how the values changed, give the typical resting range for adults for each and whether my values are within it, below it or above it, and briefly explain what a change like this usually means during slow, paced breathing. Do not diagnose, do not name any illness, and do not give medical advice or instructions. If a value is outside the typical range, only say that such values can vary for many ordinary reasons and may be worth mentioning to a doctor if it keeps happening. Write plain text with no lists, headings or Markdown. Answer in English.

Before you start

Ultra Talking Pulse uses your front camera to estimate your pulse, breathing rate and heart rate variability, and offers a guided breathing exercise.

• This is not a medical device. It is for general wellness and information only. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. Do not use it for any medical decision; if you are worried about your health, talk to a doctor.
• The camera is on only while a measurement or exercise is running, and only after you press a start button.
• Video is processed on this phone by the Presage SmartSpectra SDK. Ultra Talking Pulse never records, saves or uploads video or images.
• Results are shown on screen only. They are not saved and disappear when you close the app.
• The app connects to Presage's servers to verify its credentials and count usage. The SDK's optional anonymous usage statistics are turned off.
• AI explanation (off unless you turn it on): the measured numbers, never images, are sent to Presage and a language model to get a short explanation. It is written by an AI and can be wrong.
• Measure only yourself, or someone who has agreed to it.

You can read this again or withdraw your consent at any time from the Privacy and consent button.
